subject: Request: Exceptional Pricing Approval — Hosted API (>20% discount) — Quasar Health
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing approval needed — Quasar Health hosted API >20% discount request

Ben / Mina —

Quasar Health (contact: Ruben Salazar) just returned a formal ask: they need a >20% unit discount on Hosted API pricing to move forward and are requesting our best commercial terms by end of week. Key details:

- Ask: 30% discount off list CP/token for first 12 months on a committed 120M token/month baseline (12-month term).
- Rationale: strategic placement in their clinician workflow; tight procurement calendar — procurement wants pricing to match a competing vendor they already pilot with.
- Upside: projected run-rate of $3.4M ARR in year 1 on our baseline; potential to expand to 200M token/mo with cross-sell into embeddings and Redwood Dedicated next year.
- Risks: margin hit at >20% unless we require minimum commitments, annual true-up, and a cap on burst usage. Legal will want to limit SLA concessions.

Attachments: Quasar_SOW_v1.pdf; Quasar_Procurement_Terms.xlsx (procurement redlines).

Recommendation (initial): ask for exec signoff to approve up to 28% off conditional on: 24-month committed term OR 12-month with an upfront minimum payment + UX/technical co-marketing commitment. If we want to be aggressive, allow 30% for 24-months with a pilot-to-production clause.

Can you confirm preferred escalation path? I think this needs an EPG (executive pricing group) greenlight — can we get a binary approve/deny from Revenue Operations + Finance by EOD Thursday so I can present to their CFO?

Thanks —
Tessa
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing approval needed — Quasar Health hosted API >20% discount request

Tessa —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick thoughts:

- Hold the line on a standard 12-month minimum unless we get a meaningful upfront commitment. 30% immediately without term locks us into a very low blended unit price.
- Ask for a technical integration plan + timeline in the SOW; if they push for 30% then require performance milestones tied to the deeper discount.
- Finance (Laura) — can you run a 12/24 month P&L on the baseline and confirm the maximum allowable concession we can absorb without triggering exec-level revenue review? I think 25–28% is defensible with the right guardrails.

I’m happy to present to EPG. If Revenue Ops needs a clean approval doc, Mina, can you draft the one-pager (terms + conditions) we can push to DocuSign? We should include an annual true-up and a capped burst rate.

Ben
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing approval needed — Quasar Health hosted API >20% discount request

Ben / Tessa —

I ran the numbers off the 120M token/mo baseline. High level:

- Year 1 revenue (list price) ~ $4.2M; at 30% concession that drops to ~ $2.94M. Gross margin on Hosted API after infra + network ~= 38% at list; with 30% discount margin falls to low teens (approx 12–15%) — unacceptable without term or upsell guarantees.
- 25% keeps us at ~19–22% gross margin, which is tolerable if legal/CS lock down SLA caps and we include an annual true-up and committed minimum.
- If they agree to a 24-month term or a material upfront payment (>= 30% of year 1 committed spend), 30% becomes defensible from a cash-flow and retention perspective.

Recommendation: approve up to 28% with the following required conditions embedded in the commercial doc: 1) 12-month minimum with quarterly true-ups and a 30% upfront deposit option; OR 2) 24-month minimum with 30% off and a 15% early-termination fee pro-rated. Also require each usage cohort to stay within the committed baseline or pay overage at a higher rate.

If you want, I’ll prepare the financial summary slide for the EPG.

Laura
Director, Finance — Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing approval needed — Quasar Health hosted API >20% discount request

Thanks — I put together a concise approval packet and uploaded it to the deal folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qXqQuasarDealDoc

Contents: one-page commercial terms, risk checklist, suggested DocuSign envelope, and a redline-ready SOW. I recommend we route this to EPG with two clear ask lines: (A) Approve up to 28% w/ 12-month baseline + true-up; OR (B) Approve 30% only with 24-month term + 30% upfront payment.

I will also add a line item that Legal must include a cap on SLA credits and a clause for us to revert pricing if usage materially exceeds baseline without notice.

Mina
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Quasar_Approval_Packet.pdf
From: Ruben Salazar <ruben@quasarhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Turner <ava.turner@quasarhealth.com>, Quasar Health Procurement <procurement@quasarhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Exceptional Pricing Approval — Hosted API (>20% discount) — Quasar Health

Tessa / Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. To be transparent: Quasar procurement is on a deadline and our CFO has asked for a vendor pricing comparison this week. We are prepared to commit to a 24-month term and provide an upfront payment for year 1 if Redwood can confirm 30% off list for the first 12 months (we'd accept phasing for year 2). We also need predictable burst allowances — our clinical team expects spikes.

If you can get internal approval (and we can get a DocuSign by Friday), we can move to finalize and schedule the integration kickoff for June.

Best —
Ruben Salazar
Head of Partnerships
Quasar Health
Phone: (617) 555-0102
